title: External AI applications
subtitle: Review compatible commands, tools, agents, and MCP discovered from other AI applications.

governance.title: External sources & safety
governance.subtitle: Control source access, safety policy, approvals, and conflicts for the current execution host.

applications.enableInAdvanced: Enable external applications in Advanced settings first.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: View Hook configuration from OpenCode, Claude Code, and Codex. BitFun only reads config files without running any code.
hooks.pending: Hook discovery is still running. The catalog will update automatically.
hooks.staleAfterRefresh: The refresh failed ({{code}}). Showing the last successful result.
hooks.pollInterrupted: Automatic Hook discovery was interrupted ({{code}}). Refresh to retry; any visible content may be from the last successful check.
hooks.providerEmpty: No Hook configuration was found for this application.
hooks.providerFailed: Failed to read Hook configuration for this application; no content is available.
hooks.providerStaleEmpty: The last successful read found no Hooks, and the latest refresh also failed.
hooks.noEntries: No Hook events were found in this source.
hooks.entriesDeferred: More Hooks are available through the Show more button below.
hooks.readOnly: Read only. BitFun only displays these configurations and does not run any Hooks.

unsupported.remote: Hook inspection is not available for remote workspaces in this version.
unsupported.peer: Hook inspection is not available through Peer Device Mode in this version.

diagnosticCategory.nativeDisabled: Hooks are disabled in this native configuration.
diagnosticCategory.activationUnknown: BitFun only read the config files without running the source application, so it cannot confirm whether these Hooks are enabled. This is informational only and does not affect other features.
diagnosticCategory.staticCoverage: BitFun discovered some Hooks by reading the config files. The source application may register additional Hooks at runtime that only become visible when the app is actually running.
diagnosticCategory.opaque: Some Hook registration logic requires executing source code to identify, which static inspection cannot resolve.
diagnosticCategory.inspectionLimit: Some Hook configuration was omitted by a static inspection safety limit.
diagnosticCategory.invalidConfiguration: Some Hook configuration is invalid or could not be parsed.
diagnosticCategory.unavailable: Some Hook configuration could not be read.

actions.waitForUpdate: Another change is still being saved. Wait for it to finish before making another choice.

safeMode.title: External Safe Mode
safeMode.description: Block new external tool, agent, and MCP calls while keeping discovered commands and diagnostics visible. Calls already in progress are not cancelled.
safeMode.activeNotice: New external calls are blocked for this Host process. Calls already in progress may finish; restarting or switching the Host turns Safe Mode off.
safeMode.exited: External Safe Mode is off and eligible integrations were reconciled.

unavailable.hostDescription: View or manage external settings in Desktop.
unavailable.remoteDescription: External settings are unavailable for this remote project. Switch to a local project.
unavailable.remoteConnectionDescription: Remote connection unavailable. Retry the connection.

policy.title: Integration settings
policy.recoveryRequired: These settings are newer, so external access is off.
policy.unknownStatus: This settings state is unsupported, so external access is off.
policy.hostReadOnlyHint: View only. Manage this in Desktop.
policy.remoteReadOnlyHint: This remote project is view only. Switch to a local project to manage it.
policy.resetConfirmMessage: BitFun will preserve the newer policy in a local backup, replace it with safe defaults, and keep external execution off until you enable it.
policy.recoveryResetComplete: The incompatible policy was backed up and reset to safe defaults.
policy.capabilitiesHint: Choose how each kind of external content is discovered and used.

scope.workspaceUnavailable: Open a project to configure it separately.

errors.loadFailed: External settings could not be read. Refresh to retry.
errors.refreshFailed: The check failed. Enabled items are unchanged.
errors.mutationUnknown: Save status is unknown. Refresh to confirm.

operationErrors.rejected: The current settings do not allow this change.
operationErrors.refreshRequired: The catalog changed before this action completed. Refresh, review the current state, and try again.
operationErrors.policyIncompatible: External settings were written by a newer BitFun version. Back up and reset them before making changes.
operationErrors.internal: The action failed and no settings were changed. Try again below. If it keeps failing, contact support with the reference number.

diagnostics.summary: {{count}} items need attention. Review the details to see what is affected.

category.confirmationStateUnavailable: BitFun could not verify saved tool confirmations, so affected tools remain disabled. Check BitFun settings storage, then refresh.
category.conflictHistoryUnavailable: BitFun could not save conflict information, so affected names remain unavailable. Check BitFun settings storage, then refresh.
category.checkInProgress: One source is still being checked. Existing content remains available.
category.checkTimedOut: Checking one source took too long. Other content remains available; refresh to try again.
category.confirmationRequired: A source needs your confirmation before BitFun can use it.
category.sourceTooLarge: Some files were skipped because the source is too large. Reduce its size, then refresh.
category.invalidSettings: Some settings could not be read and were skipped. Fix the source, then refresh.
category.unreadableSource: BitFun could not read part of a source. Check file access, then refresh.
category.notSupported: This type of external content is not supported yet, so BitFun did not load or run it.
category.checkFailed: BitFun could not check one source. Other sources remain available; refresh to retry.
category.runtimeUnavailable: An MCP server from this source is unavailable. Disable it, fix its configuration or authentication, then enable it again.
category.sourceIssue: BitFun could not finish checking one source. Existing usable content remains available; refresh or review the technical details.

sources.title: Configuration sources
sources.description: Settings stay in their original locations. Open this page to check for changes automatically.
sources.globalOnly: Showing sources available to all workspaces. Open a workspace to also show sources from that project.

agents.title: Found agents
agents.description: Agents stay in their original application. Before enabling one, review its model, tools, and where it runs. BitFun asks again if its instructions or these settings change.
agents.approvalWarning: Once enabled, this agent can instruct the selected model to use the tools shown above. BitFun asks again if its instructions, model, tools, or configuration sources change.
agents.modelResolvedFromParentAtTaskStart: Resolved from the parent session when the task starts
agents.executionDomain: Runs in: this computer and current workspace
agents.unavailableToolsUnknown: Names were not provided by this host

agentChanges.unavailable: {{name}} is no longer available for new tasks ({{state}}). Review its current model, tools, source, or name conflict below.
agentChanges.unavailableMany: {{count}} enabled agents are no longer available for new tasks. Review their current settings below.

agentCompatibility.ready_with_degradation: Supported, but some settings will not apply

configurationUnavailable.reason: BitFun could not read its model settings, so this agent cannot be enabled.
configurationUnavailable.nextStep: Check BitFun model settings, then refresh.

modelUnavailable.reason: The requested model is not available in BitFun.
modelUnavailable.nextStep: Choose an available model in the source application, or configure an available model in BitFun, then refresh.

toolUnavailable.nextStep: Remove or replace these tools in the source application, then refresh.

promptMissing.reason: This agent is missing a valid prompt.
promptMissing.nextStep: Add a prompt in the source application, then refresh.

unsupportedSetting.reason: BitFun does not support the {{setting}} setting, so this agent cannot be enabled.
unsupportedSetting.nextStep: Remove that setting in the source application, then refresh.

ignoredSetting.reason: BitFun does not support the {{setting}} setting and will ignore it. This does not affect usage.

invalidDefinition.nextStep: Fix the agent configuration in the source application, then refresh.

unsupportedBehavior.reason: This agent uses settings that BitFun does not support, so it cannot be enabled.
unsupportedBehavior.nextStep: Update the agent in the source application, then refresh.

ignoredOption.reason: BitFun does not support this setting and will ignore it. This does not affect usage.

agentConflicts.title: Agents with the same name
agentConflicts.description: BitFun does not choose silently. Pending and current choices stay visible, and a choice is remembered until one of these agents changes.
agentConflicts.disableAll: Do not use any of these
agentConflicts.pending: Choose which agent to use for future tasks. Choosing an external agent also confirms the model, tools, and where it runs as shown below.
agentConflicts.currentSelection: The current choice is used for new tasks. Choose another option above to change it.
agentConflicts.currentSelectionUnavailable: This source is still selected, but it is currently disabled or unavailable for new tasks. Enable or repair it, choose another option, or keep this name unavailable.
agentConflicts.keptUnavailable: This agent name is kept unavailable. Choose an option above when you want to use one.
agentConflicts.selectionApproves: This choice confirms the model, tools, run location, and configuration sources shown below.

mcp.title: Found MCP servers
mcp.description: MCP settings stay in the source application. External servers are read-only here; disable one or change it in its original application.
mcp.changePolicy: BitFun asks again before loading a changed server configuration.

failureReasons.authentication: Authentication is required for this MCP server.
failureReasons.timeout: The MCP server did not finish starting before its timeout.
failureReasons.commandUnavailable: The configured MCP command could not be started.
failureReasons.workingDirectoryUnavailable: The configured MCP working directory is unavailable.
failureReasons.connectionFailed: BitFun could not connect to the MCP server.
failureReasons.protocolFailed: The MCP server did not complete the MCP startup handshake.
failureReasons.nativeConfigurationUnavailable: BitFun could not read the current MCP configuration.
failureReasons.hostReadOnly: This host can discover MCP servers but cannot run them.
failureReasons.configurationChanged: The MCP configuration changed before activation. Refresh and confirm it again.
failureReasons.configurationInvalid: The MCP configuration cannot be used by the BitFun runtime.
failureReasons.hostUnavailable: The MCP runtime is not available in this host.
failureReasons.installFailed: BitFun could not register this MCP server with the runtime.
failureReasons.preparationFailed: BitFun could not prepare this MCP configuration for activation.
failureReasons.serverMissing: The MCP server is no longer registered with the runtime.
failureReasons.runtimeFailed: The MCP server failed or stopped unexpectedly.
failureReasons.stopped: The MCP server is not currently running.
failureReasons.statusUnavailable: BitFun could not read the current MCP server status.
failureReasons.other: The MCP server failed to start. Check its source configuration and BitFun logs.

mcp.runtimeUnavailableGuidance: Disable this server, fix the source configuration or authentication, then enable it again. Restarting BitFun is usually not required.
mcp.unsupportedGuidance: Change this setting in the source application, then refresh.
mcp.emptyGuidance: BitFun looks for MCP servers in the following locations but found none:

emptyLocation.envConfig: File pointed to by OPENCODE_CONFIG environment variable

mcpApprovals.title: MCP servers to review
mcpApprovals.description: BitFun found executable or network configuration from another AI application. It is not started or contacted until you confirm it.
mcpApprovals.compactWarning: Enabling can run this command with your user permissions or connect to this service; the server can receive data sent in tool calls.
mcpApprovals.warning: Local commands can read the listed environment variables, and remote requests can send the listed headers. Review these details before enabling.

mcpConflicts.title: MCP servers with the same name
mcpConflicts.description: BitFun does not choose silently. Choose the BitFun or external server to use; the choice is remembered until one of these configurations changes.
mcpConflicts.pending: Choose one server. Choosing an external server also confirms that configuration.
mcpConflicts.currentSelection: The current choice is used. Choose another available option to change it.
mcpConflicts.nativeDisabled: Enable this BitFun server before selecting it

tools.title: Found tools
tools.description: Tool code stays in its original location. BitFun does not run it while checking the source.
tools.targetScope: This action applies to every tool provided by this source.

toolApprovals.title: Tools to review
toolApprovals.description: Before enabling tool code from another application, review where the code comes from and what it can access.
toolApprovals.warning: Tool code runs with your user permissions and inherits your environment variables. It is not isolated by an operating-system sandbox. Processes it starts may keep running after you cancel.

toolReason.approval_required: Review this tool file's access before enabling it.
toolReason.declined: You chose to keep these tools disabled.
toolReason.disabled: The source or its tool capability is disabled by policy.
toolReason.active: The tool code is loaded and ready to use.
toolReason.conflict: Another tool has the same name.
toolReason.unsupported: This tool file contains code or operations that BitFun does not support.
toolReason.runtime_unavailable: The required JavaScript run environment is unavailable.
toolReason.load_failed: BitFun could not load this tool file.

toolNextStep.approval_required: Review the source and access above, then enable or keep these tools disabled.
toolNextStep.declined: Review the source and access above before enabling these tools.
toolNextStep.disabled: Enable this source or its tool capability before using these tools.
toolNextStep.active: No action needed. Disable these tools to stop using this source's tools.
toolNextStep.conflict: Choose which tool to use below, or leave them disabled.
toolNextStep.unsupported: Change the source to a single JavaScript file supported by BitFun, then refresh.
toolNextStep.runtime_unavailable: Install or repair Node.js, then refresh. You can continue without these external JavaScript tools while the run environment is unavailable.
toolNextStep.load_failed: Fix the source and refresh, or keep these tools disabled.

toolConflicts.title: Tools with the same name
toolConflicts.description: Pending and current choices stay visible. Until you choose, BitFun keeps using an available local or MCP tool; if none is available, this name stays disabled. Choices are remembered until the available tools change.
toolConflicts.pending: Choose which tool to use when this name is called.
toolConflicts.currentSelection: The current choice is used for this tool name. Choose another option above to change it.
toolConflicts.currentSelectionUnavailable: This tool source is still selected, but it is currently disabled or unavailable. Enable or repair it, or choose another tool.

conflicts.title: Commands with the same name
conflicts.description: BitFun does not choose silently. Pending and current choices stay visible, and a choice is remembered until one of the sources changes.
conflicts.pending: Choose an available source to use this command.
conflicts.currentSelection: The current source is used for this command. Choose another available source above to change it.
conflicts.currentSelectionUnavailable: This command source is still selected, but it cannot run in its current state. Choose an available source or fix this source first.

opencode.title: OpenCode extensions
opencode.description: External capabilities discovered from OpenCode-compatible configurations.

reference.description: Named local directories from OpenCode configuration
reference.effect: Shows references in workspace directory views and explicit directory navigation.
reference.risk: References do not grant additional file access.

subagent.effect: Allows calling agents defined in OpenCode.
subagent.risk: Agents can make model calls; confirm the source is trusted.

command.effect: Allows calling OpenCode commands in BitFun.

mcp.effect: Allows connecting to MCP servers configured in OpenCode.
mcp.risk: MCP servers can start local processes or connect to remote addresses.

tool.effect: Allows using tools defined in OpenCode.
tool.risk: Tool code runs with your user permissions, not in a sandbox.
